fields.name: SMF119LEN
fields.description: Record length. This field and the next field (total of four bytes) form the RDW (record descriptor word). See “Standard SMF Record Header” on page 13-1 for a detailed description.

fields.name: SMF119FLG
fields.description: System indicator Bit Meaning When Set 0 New record format 1 Subtypes used 2 Reserved. 3-6 Version indicators* 7 System is running in PR/SM mode.*See “Standard SMF Record Header” on page 13-1 for a detailed description.

fields.name: SMF119TME
fields.description: Time since midnight, in hundredths of a second, that the record was moved into the SMF buffer.

fields.name: SMF119DTE
fields.description: Date when the record was moved into the SMF buffer, in the form 0cyydddF. See “Standard SMF Record Header” on page 13-1 for a detailed description.

fields.name: SMF119SID
fields.description: System identification (from the SMFPRMxx SID parameter).

fields.name: SMF119TRN
fields.description: Number of triplets in this record. A triplet is a set of three SMF fields (offset/length/number values) that defines a section of the record. The offset is the offset from the RDW.

fields.name: SMF119IDOff
fields.description: Offset to TCP/IP identification section from RDW.

fields.name: SMF119TI_SYSName
fields.description: System name from SYSNAME in IEASYSxx

fields.name: SMF119TI_SysplexName
fields.description: Sysplex name from SYSPLEX in COUPLExx

fields.name: SMF119TI_ReleaseID
fields.description: z/OS Communications Server TCP/IP release identifier

fields.name: SMF119TI_Comp
fields.description: TCP/IP subcomponent (right padded with blanks): FTPC FTP Client FTPS FTP server IP IP layer STACK Entire TCP/IP stack TCP TCP layer TN3270C TN3270 Client TN3270S TN3270 server UDP UDP layer

fields.name: SMF119TI_ASName
fields.description: Started task qualifier or address space name of address space that writes this SMF record

fields.name: SMF119TI_UserID
fields.description: User ID of security context under which this SMF record is written

fields.name: SMF119TI_ASID
fields.description: ASID of address space that writes this SMF record

fields.name: SMF119TI_Reason
fields.description: Reason for writing this SMF record: X'08' Event record X'C0' Interval statistics record, more records follow X'80' Interval statistics record, last record in set X'60' End-of-statistics record, more records follow X'20' End-of-statistics re

fields.name: SMF119SP_IFDuration
fields.description: Duration of recording interval in microseconds, where bit 51 is equivalent to one microsecond

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFLnkHome
fields.description: Interface HOME address. For IPv6 interfaces, additional addresses might be specified in subsequent HOME IP address sections.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFDesc
fields.description: Interface Description (TCPIP PROFILE keyword for LINK or INTERFACE type.) Possible values include: ATM, CDLC, CTC, ETHERnet, ETHEROR802.3, FDDI, HCH, IBMTR, IP, IPAQENET, IPAQIDIO, IPAQTR, MPCPTP, OSAENET, OSAFDDI, SAMEHOST, Unknown, 802.3,

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFSPeed
fields.description: Speed Guideline: If the interface speed exceeds x'FFFFFFFF', then this field contains x'FFFFFFFF'. If this field contains x'FFFFFFFF', then use the SMF119IS_IFHSpeed field to determine the interface speed.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFInError
fields.description: Number of inbound packets in error

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFInUProt
fields.description: Number of inbound packets with unknown protocol.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFOutError
fields.description: Number of outbound packets in error

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFIQDXName
fields.description: For IPAQENET and IPAQENET6 interfaces that are defined with CHPIDTYPE OSX and with an associated IQDX interface, this field is the associated IQDX interface name. Otherwise, this field is blank and the following four counters are not valid.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFInIQDXBytes
fields.description: Number of inbound bytes that were received over the associated IQDX interface. This field is valid only if the SMF119IS_IFIQDXName field is not blank.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFInIQDXUniC
fields.description: Number of inbound unicast packets that were received over the associated IQDX interface. This field is valid only if the SMF119IS_IFIQDXName field is not blank.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFOutIQDXBytes
fields.description: Number of outbound bytes that were sent over the associated IQDX interface. This field is valid only if the SMF119IS_IFIQDXName field is not blank.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFOutIQDXUniC
fields.description: Number of outbound unicast packets that were sent over the associated IQDX interface. This field is valid only if the SMF119IS_IFIQDXName field is not blank.

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFPNetID
fields.description: Physical network ID. This field is valid for only IPAQENET and IPAQENET6 interfaces that are active for Shared Memory Communications over RDMA (SMC-R).

fields.name: SMF119IS_IFAddIntfName
fields.description: Interface name, used to correlate this additional address to the interface statistics record in Table 169
